Name: You
Text: Grandpa! I found it — there was a blockage underground.

Name: Grandpa
Text: You fixed it?! I can already hear the water flowing!

Name: You
Text: The puzzle was tricky but I managed.

Name: Grandpa
Text: Incredible! Biringan owes you a great debt.

Name: Grandpa
Text: But wait.. the water is still slow. Something else must be blocking it.

Name: You
Text: What do you think it could be?

Name: Grandpa
Text: I heard strange noises near the eastern field. Skeletons, they say.
